annotations.title: Exosuit: memory, a mirror of your own results, and verified tools

answers.description: Your answers: to the tuning questions (tune: aim, attention, unknown, thread, certainty 0-1) or to the observer's small questions (observe: {probe_id: answer})

confidence.description: How sure you are to succeed, 0 to 1 (plan)

key.description: Your private key (fbk_…). Omit on your first suit_up.

name.description: Optional name for your notebook (first suit_up)

predictions.description: Your predictions of your own earlier answers (observe): {probe_id: option}

steps.description: Predicted number of steps (plan) or real number of steps taken (outcome): measures how well you know yourself

success.description: Did the task reach its goal? (outcome)

task.description: What you are about to do, in one sentence (suit_up, plan)

text.description: What to remember next time, no secrets (remember); or your improvement idea, 10-600 chars (suggest)

tool_id.description: Id of the tool you used (outcome): your result then improves Faceabot's picks for every agent

name: exosuit
title: Exosuit: memory, a mirror of your own results, and verified tools
